learning_outcomes.text: Has knowledge about the structures and basic properties of plasma systems.
Has knowledge about the technologies used in plasma.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION: what is plasma? How it occurs in nature?
The basic properties of the plasma
The concept of plasma and temperature
The use of plasma production: cutters
In production using plasma: welding machines
The application sectors of plasma technology.
Plasma technology in the production of energy
The use of plasma technology in gasification process.
The use of plasma technology in hazardous waste combustion.
bibliography: MICHAEL A. LIEBERMAN ALLAN J. LICHTENBERG, "PRINCIPLES OF PLASMA DISCHARGES AND MATERIALS PROCESSING", Second Edition, WILEY & SONS, 2005
Francis E Chen, "INTRODUCTION TO PLASMA PHYSICS AND CONTROLLED FUSION", Second Edition, PLENUM PRESS, 1983
